headline: Sony profile documents analog models and system simulators for automotive LiDAR sensor verification
fact: A Sony Semiconductor Solutions feature profiles an Automotive Business Division engineer whose work included developing analog models and system simulators to test SPAD ToF depth-sensor circuit and signal-processing designs. The profile says she designed and verified an analog sensor circuit in 2022 and moved into sensor-circuit evaluation in 2023.

sources.title: Driving toward a world free of road accidents: a story behind our original SPAD ToF Depth Sensor for Automotive LiDAR Applications
sources.summary: Sony Semiconductor Solutions' May 9, 2023 feature identifies the engineer, her Automotive Business Division affiliation, and the analog-model, system-simulator, circuit-verification, and sensor-evaluation work.
